title: Norway proposes temporary restrictions on AI glasses in selected places
claim: Norway's government announced that it will propose a temporary ban on AI glasses in selected public and privacy-sensitive places while developing permanent regulation.
summary: The October 5 government release says the proposal may cover parks, beaches, museums, shopping centres, public events, schools, children's spaces, healthcare facilities and changing-room environments. Exact technology scope and statutory text remain under development; exceptions are contemplated for vulnerable groups and socially beneficial uses.

source.publisher: Norwegian Ministry of Digitalisation and Public Governance
